Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-maintenance.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: At 8d4881a all ten fields remain; zero-leaf/zero-row defaults and omitted undefined localizability persist. The closed WeightedCoverage child only repaired importance; MassRatio is separate work. Independent read-only acceptance review; no new runtime witness.

Remaining / next action: Migrate the ten remaining RecallSignature fields without conflating count coverage, weighted coverage, row-count-normalized external mass and localizability. Preserve absence/support, decide checked construction, and update stale migration counts.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: maintenance. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Preserve ADR 0003 signature migration. Explicit residual from MassRatio polarity fix: forged NaN operands still stored although ratio abstains; inspect construction/consumer consequences before claiming closure. New organization readouts must use explicit counts/denominators rather than inheriting these fields blindly.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.
